{{Quote|Nothing must interfere with my shipment to the Nodgra system.|Abdi-Badawzi|<ref name="Journal2">{{JournalCite|2|Out of the Cradle}}</ref>}}
The '''Nodgra system''' was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]]. In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Abdi-Badawzi]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] forced the young [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Drake Paulsen]] to work as a [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]] aboard the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Seldom Different]]'' that would serve as a decoy on a smuggling run to the Nodgra [[Star system/Legends|system]]. In another instance, Badawzi was offering a substantial payment for a pair of chemical tanks containing two volatile, explosive liquids to be transported to the system.

==Description==
The Nodgra system was located in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated at least three [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel away from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]<ref name="Journal2" /> of the [[Socorro system/Legends|Socorro system]]<ref name="Socorro">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref> in the Outer Rim's [[Kibilini sector/Legends|Kibilini sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
{{Quote|Just say what you want, Abdi.''"<br />"''Safe delivery of a small cargo.''"<br />"''Where?''"<br />"''The location isn't important to you.''"<br />"''And the cargo?''"<br />"''You needn't concern yourself.''"<br />"''Then what am I doing here?''"<br />"''You will be the decoy.|Drake Paulsen and Abdi-Badawzi|<ref name="Journal2" />}}
[[File:AbdiBadawzi.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Abdi-Badawzi wished on two occasions for a cargo to be transported to the Nodgra system.]]
In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]],<ref name="3 BBY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of {{JournalCite|2|Out of the Cradle}} to [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].</ref> the Socorro-based [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Abdi-Badawzi]] wished to have an illegal cargo delivered to the Nodgra [[Star system/Legends|system]]. To that end, he had the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Kaine Paulsen]] and his [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Drake Paulsen|Drake]], captured and, threatening to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Kaine, forced Drake to agree to take part in the smuggling run as a [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]] of a decoy [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Badawzi did not disclose what the cargo was and at first also did not reveal what the location of the delivery was. The crime lord then ordered his [[Coynite/Legends|Coynite]] personal [[Security guard/Legends|guard]] [[Tra'Parr'Sratt]] to ensure that the ''[[Seldom Different]]'', the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] used as the decoy under the [[Captain/Legends|captaincy]] of [[Elias Halbert]], returned to Socorro intact. At that point, Badawzi also stated out loud that nothing could be allowed to interfere with the shipment to the Nodgra system, to which Parr'Sratt responded with the [[Coynite language]] acknowledgment "Al'ha'gra."<ref name="Journal2" />

When Drake subsequently looked at his bound and gagged [[Parent/Legends|father]], the latter discreetly gave him several [[Limb/Legends|hand]] signals, letting him know of the minimum travel [[Time/Legends|time]] to the system as well as telling the young smuggler that he would be safe during the trip. Afterward, the ''Seldom Different'' departed Socorro, and two days later, the [[Light freighter/Legends|freighter]] was intercepted by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Inquisitor (Star Destroyer)|''Inquisitor'']], whose boarding party did not find anything illegal aboard the smaller [[Freighter/Legends|craft]]. Later, Parr'Sratt transported Drake to Kaine's light freighter ''[[Miss Chance]]'' in<ref name="Journal2" /> the Outer Rim's<ref name="OuterRim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] before returning to Socorro alongside Halbert.<ref name="Journal2" />

{{RPGseed}}
In another instance, Abdi-Badawzi was also offering a substantial payment for a smuggling run to the Nodgra system to transport two old chemical tanks containing volatile liquids that reacted explosively to each other. The nature of the cargo was not being revealed until someone agreed to make the run, and the job offer was not taken up by anyone for some amount of time despite rumors spreading about it. Eventually, a group of individuals sought out further information about the potential deal.<ref name="Journal2" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SWAJ2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Nodgra system was introduced in ''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 2.]]
The Nodgra system was first mentioned in the short story "[[Out of the Cradle]]," which was written by [[Patricia A. Jackson]] and published in the [[May]] [[1994]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 2|second issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Journal2" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Nodgra system in grid square L-20.<ref name="TEA" />

The printing of "Out of the Cradle" in ''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 2 also included a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure seed for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' in which Abdi-Badawzi is offering the job offer of a smuggling run to the system. The adventure seed suggests that Badawzi can either load the cargo aboard the player characters' starship or trick them into unwittingly playing the part of a decoy, which would lead to them running into trouble with Galactic Empire authorities. This article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="Journal2" />
